_regime_alias_note: `regime` mirrors `state`. Consumers were calling .get('regime') against a payload that only had 'state', so both_wrong aborts never fired. Both keys are now present; new code should read `state`.
state_explanation: RESIDUAL RACE DEGRADED - the forecast's week-0 value is REBASED to today's score, so its residual is 0.00 by construction, not by skill. Absolute residuals: forecast 0.0 · j6 1.9 · devils 19.2. No ratio is shown because dividing by a pinned zero manufactures one, and no crown is awarded because J6 cannot beat an anchor. This board measures nothing forward until a delayed-grade ledger lands.

grading_contract.cadence: one history row per SWEEP (not weekly, despite older comments)
grading_contract.known_flaw: the forecast curve is REBASED to today's score, so its week-0 residual is ~0 by construction. This board therefore measures the anchor, not forward skill, and no delayed-grade ledger exists yet.
grading_contract.what_would_fix_it: freeze a vintage curve and grade its week+k against the realized score k weeks later, the way price_accuracy grades a 7d target

da_role_note: devils_today = 100 - forecast_today, same date. It is a FALSIFIER reflection, not an independent model - when the forecast residual is pinned at 0, DA's residual collapses to |2*actual - 100| purely as arithmetic. It should not be read as a third horse that lost.
lev_context: mechanical state 'info_only' — read the numbers, not the label
lev_context_note: This describes what the MECHANICAL layer can see, not what you should do. 'No mechanical edge' means this layer has nothing to offer right now — it is a statement about the layer, not a ban on trading. Your read is a separate input and it outranks this.
doctrine: Three-way race: forecast (pure macro), DA (inverse falsifier), J6 (empire intel-curated). State values: forecast_winning_decisive (bull thesis confirmed) | devils_winning_decisive (inverse path) | j6_winning_decisive (empire intel adding alpha, promote overrides) | forecast_leading / devils_leading / j6_leading (mild edges) | convergence (rare alignment, highest conviction) | both_wrong (2-way models broken) | all_three_wrong (stale model, re-run 6-model triangulation, leverage zero) | mixed (no clear winner). J6 states only fire after 3+ sweeps of J6 history (warm-up).
